paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.37% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.69%) and Dow Jones weakest (-1.23%). Brent crude changed -1.30% to 111.7. Gold changed -1.29% to 4,007.8999. Bitcoin changed -0.31% to 80,824.25. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of +0.71%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+5.17%) and Newmont (-4.59%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Musk’s bet of the century (FT World). The proposed Tesla-SpaceX merger is going all in on AI Deals and capital markets: US executives quit $25bn gas venture over claims of secret Russian control (FT Markets). Former CEO of Polar Train LNG tells FT that energy giant Novatek financed and held reins of strategic Alaska project without Washington’s approval Central banks and macro: Israeli central bank rejects Netanyahu’s plan to use crypto to evade sanctions (FT World). Critics say prime minister’s proposal would turn country into an economic pariah Central banks and macro: Oil hits $117 for first time since April on fears of flare-up in Iran hostilities (FT Markets). Rise in energy prices pushes US inflation expectations higher Geopolitics and trade: Davos in the Desert’s ‘old fox’ Richard Attias faces his latest test (FT World). Power broker behind kingdom’s flagship investment conference has weathered scandal and setbacks.
